registration_applications_other_note_che.name: registration_applications_other_note_check
registration_applications_other_note_che.value: "registration_applications"."verification_method" is distinct from 'other' or "registration_applications"."verification_note" is not null

session_revocations_lease_check.name: session_revocations_lease_check
session_revocations_lease_check.value: "session_revocations"."state" <> 'executing' or ("session_revocations"."lease_owner" is not null and "session_revocations"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

cohort_status_events_archive_reason_chec.name: cohort_status_events_archive_reason_check
cohort_status_events_archive_reason_chec.value: ("cohort_status_events"."to_status" <> 'archived' and "cohort_status_events"."from_status" is distinct from 'archived') or "cohort_status_events"."reason" is not null

group_proposals_closed_check.name: group_proposals_closed_check
group_proposals_closed_check.value:
("group_proposals"."state" = 'open') = ("group_proposals"."closed_real_at" is null)
          and ("group_proposals"."closed_real_at" is null) = ("group_proposals"."closed_business_at" is null)
          and ("group_proposals"."closed_real_at" is null) = ("group_proposals"."closed_by_kind" is null)

group_proposals_closed_by_actor_check.name: group_proposals_closed_by_actor_check
group_proposals_closed_by_actor_check.value: "group_proposals"."closed_by_kind" is null or ("group_proposals"."closed_by_kind" = 'user') = ("group_proposals"."closed_by_user_id" is not null)

groups_dissolved_check.name: groups_dissolved_check
groups_dissolved_check.value:
("groups"."status" = 'dissolved') = ("groups"."dissolved_real_at" is not null)
          and ("groups"."status" <> 'dissolved' or "groups"."dissolve_reason" is not null)

advisor_assignments_ended_check.name: advisor_assignments_ended_check
advisor_assignments_ended_check.value:
("advisor_assignments"."valid_to" is null) = ("advisor_assignments"."ended_real_at" is null)
          and ("advisor_assignments"."valid_to" is null or ("advisor_assignments"."ended_by_user_id" is not null and length(btrim(coalesce("advisor_assignments"."end_reason", ''))) > 0))

opportunity_links_ended_check.name: opportunity_links_ended_check
opportunity_links_ended_check.value:
("opportunity_links"."valid_to" is null) = ("opportunity_links"."ended_real_at" is null)
          and ("opportunity_links"."valid_to" is null or ("opportunity_links"."ended_by_user_id" is not null and length(btrim(coalesce("opportunity_links"."end_reason", ''))) > 0))

managed_items_receiver_schedule_check.name: managed_items_receiver_schedule_check
managed_items_receiver_schedule_check.value: "managed_items"."status" = 'draft' or "managed_items"."receiver_unit" = 'none' or ("managed_items"."stage_id" is not null and "managed_items"."due_at" is not null)

managed_items_published_check.name: managed_items_published_check
managed_items_published_check.value:
"managed_items"."status" = 'draft' or ("managed_items"."actual_opened_at" is not null
          and "managed_items"."current_content_version_id" is not null and "managed_items"."current_schema_version_id" is not null)

evaluation_status_events_state_check.name: evaluation_status_events_state_check
evaluation_status_events_state_check.value: "evaluation_status_events"."to_state" in ('draft','counted','historical','returned','invalidated') and ("evaluation_status_events"."from_state" is null or "evaluation_status_events"."from_state" in ('draft','counted','historical','returned','invalidated'))

evaluator_assignments_ended_check.name: evaluator_assignments_ended_check
evaluator_assignments_ended_check.value:
("evaluator_assignments"."valid_to" is null) = ("evaluator_assignments"."ended_real_at" is null)
          and ("evaluator_assignments"."valid_to" is null or length(btrim(coalesce("evaluator_assignments"."reason", ''))) > 0)
          and ("evaluator_assignments"."removal_choice" is null or "evaluator_assignments"."valid_to" is not null)

showcase_drafts_authorization_check.name: showcase_drafts_authorization_check
showcase_drafts_authorization_check.value:
("showcase_drafts"."authorization_kind" is null) = ("showcase_drafts"."authorization_ref" is null)
          and ("showcase_drafts"."authorization_kind" is null or "showcase_drafts"."authorization_kind" in ('signoff','external'))
